'''John Shields Shields' Mains''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[John Shields]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls88.htm Shields' Mains], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319193949/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls88.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
